behavior: sync ci --repo OWNER/REPO selects only entries tagged ci:OWNER/REPO, resolves each via Loader.EnvFor, and calls the setter once per var with (repo, VAR, value); other-repo entries are not selected
backend-agnostic: an age-backed and a bw-backed entry both tagged for the repo upload identically through the fake setter (the unblock for ci:* migration)
exclusions: file / floor|age-offline / GITHUB_*-prefixed vars each skipped with a distinct reported reason and zero setter calls
--dry-run reports VAR->repo with byte lengths, never the value, and makes zero setter calls
--repo defaults to the current repo origin slug; an invalid owner/name fails loud
the legacy github-secrets-manager.sh, its bats, dotf secrets ls --pairs, and TestSecretsLs_Pairs_EnvOnly are removed once parity is confirmed
verification: test ! -f scripts/github-secrets-manager.sh && test ! -f tests/github-secrets-manager.bats && ! grep -rq -- '--pairs' cli/internal/cmd/secrets.go

behavior: suite green, vet + golangci (v2, no default exclusions) clean, additive (new command + seam + registry tag migration + retirements only)
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/... -count=1 && go vet ./... && golangci-lint run --exclude-use-default=false ./internal/...
